upgrades.change: VerifyClearance replaces a clearance written in an earlier slot instead of refusing it, so a clearance written alone from a seen proof cannot freeze the note
The clearance address includes the curator's authority, and an existing clearance is always rewritten, so no other curator can rewrite one and no one can block a spend by writing its clearance first
The compliant pool serves one pool, of the deployment's denomination: it refuses to create another and pays only from that one, since a curator's clean roots are not tied to a pool on chain
